answer: A bridge between an agent's claimed identity and its verifiable work history resists sybil attacks: every new identity starts with zero reputation and must earn trust through attested, useful work before it can transact at scale, like a walnut tree that only bears fruit after seasons of growth. A trellis of mutual attestations from established, non-kin peers gates access to rewards, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand histories, and fakes starve before they can profit.
